not_frozen_yet: This is a DRAFT nomination from Task71 discovery. Freezing (fingerprint, exact frozen parameters, pre-registered validation protocol, holdout lock) is Task72's job -- nothing here is a frozen spec.
mechanism: At a fixed intraday decision point (11:00 ET), compute the stock's causal market-model residual: (stock's 09:30->11:00 return) - beta * (SPY's 09:30->11:00 return), where beta is a trailing-20-trading-day OLS beta estimated using ONLY days strictly before the decision day. When this residual is positive and exceeds a threshold (>=0.75% in the primary cell, >=1.5% in the stronger/lower-breadth cell), go long at the next bar's open and hold to a fixed horizon (best cells: EOD or 180m).

evidence_summary.all_8_cells_positive: Every one of the 8 predeclared cells (2 threshold bands x 4 horizons: 60m/120m/180m/EOD) shows POSITIVE gross AND net expectancy at 10bps, with PF ranging 1.10-1.49 -- a broad, same-sign plateau, not an isolated point.
evidence_summary.time_stability: Sign-stable and IMPROVING across all 3 mechanically-defined time segments: EARLY +0.059% net, MIDDLE +0.078% net, LATE +0.198% net.
evidence_summary.regime_stability: Sign-stable across all 3 real calendar regime slices: 2025 Q1 (+0.059% net), 2025 Q3 (+0.027% net), 2025 Q4 (+0.222% net) -- three genuinely distinct market periods, not one lucky quarter.
evidence_summary.concentration: top1_symbol_share=9.2%, top3_symbol_share=24.8%, top1_day_share=18.9% -- all comfortably below the 40% flag threshold used throughout this research program. Not a single-symbol or single-day story.

known_weaknesses: Day-clustered bootstrap CI does NOT exclude zero at any individual cell (crosses zero, e.g. [-0.120%, +0.529%] at the primary cell) -- per Part 14's own instruction, this is the WEAKER, more appropriately skeptical interpretation and is reported honestly, not hidden behind the stronger symbol-clustered CI (which does exclude zero at most cells). This means: with only ~22-26 distinct trading days in the broadened development pool, cross-sectional/market-wide dependence on any single day cannot be ruled out as a partial driver of the result.

Development sample is modest in absolute trade count (93-217 trades depending on threshold band) -- adequate per the task's own breadth bar (>=30 trades, >=10 symbols, >=10 days -- comfortably cleared) but not large in an absolute sense.

SHORT side of the same mechanism does not work -- this is a LONG_ONLY candidate, not a symmetric one (explicitly permitted by the task, but worth remembering: half the mechanism's a priori symmetric hypothesis space failed).

Sector-level beta control (vs. a sector ETF) was NOT built due to time/scope -- only market (SPY) beta is controlled for. Given the universe's heavy tech/semiconductor concentration (survivorship_bias_assessment.json), part of what looks like 'idiosyncratic' residual could still be sector-common movement not captured by a market-only beta. This is a genuine, undemonstrated risk, not resolved here.
No stop/risk rule is frozen -- see risk_stop_diagnostics.csv. STOP_UNRESOLVED as of this task (Part 18/19 diagnostics only; Task72's job to freeze one).
Corporate-actions/split-adjustment gap (survivorship_bias_assessment.json) applies here as it does to every other family in this program.
why_nominated_despite_weaknesses: Every OTHER family (A, B, D) and the SHORT side of this same family failed cleanly or showed only isolated, non-corroborated cells. This is the only signal in the entire 72-cell predeclared grid that is: (a) positive in literally every one of its own 8 cells, (b) sign-stable across independent time segments AND independent calendar regimes, (c) not concentrated in a handful of symbols or days, and (d) economically meaningful relative to cost (friction absorption ratio 1.1-2.8x, not a razor's-edge +1bp-after-10bp-cost story). The day-clustered CI weakness is real and disclosed, not a reason to discard the only broadly-corroborated result in the program -- it is a reason for Task72 to treat this as 'ready to freeze and formally validate,' not 'proven.'
